connection.TGxhbWFQYXJzZVJlc3RDbGllbnQ.s.source:
A connection to [LlamaParse](https://docs.cloud.llamaindex.ai/llamaparse/getting_started), LlamaIndex's document platform: parsing documents into markdown, text and structured items, extracting structured data against a schema, classifying documents against rules, and splitting a document that holds many.

Requires an API key for Bearer authentication.  Get your API key from the [LlamaCloud dashboard](https://cloud.llamaindex.ai/).

An API key belongs to one region and is rejected by the other.  When the configured region rejects the key, the connection tries the other known region on the next ping and moves itself to whichever one accepts it.
